title: simple-popover
description: A popover alertdialog that is positioned next to a target element

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Accessible name for the popover's content. Consumers wire this by setting aria-label on the simple-popover host (the host title attribute, then the first slotted heading, are fallbacks). A name set only on the host never reaches shadow DOM nodes, so the value is forwarded to the inner #content div.

attributes.name: content-role
attributes.description: Role of the content wrapper. Defaults to a non-modal "dialog" when a name is available, "group" otherwise. Use "none" when the popover only wraps another named widget, such as a listbox.
